 Go Shiozaki & Suwama Prevail in a Thriller Against Jun & Rei Saito as the AJPW “REAL WORLD TAG LEAGUE 2026” Begins
 1 minute ago 
 Photo Credit: All Japan Pro-Wrestling 
 Photo Credit: All Japan Pro-Wrestling 
 Go Shiozaki & Suwama Prevail in a Thriller Against Jun & Rei Saito as the AJPW “REAL WORLD TAG LEAGUE 2026” Begins
 By: Lewis Carlan 
 After hyping it up for over a month, the AJPW “REAL WORLD TAG LEAGUE 2026” finally got underway on Nov. 15th and it’s fair to say it lived up to all expectations. The event was a complete sell out as 1,511 fans packed Korakuen Hall and were very vocal throughout the entire show.
 The main event featured a huge Block A match-up as the team of Go Shiozaki & Suwama faced the AJPW World Tag Team Champions Jun & Rei Saito. What transpired was a phenomenal match that one could equate to an all out war as both teams fought hard to earn their first two points of the tournament.
 Shiozaki’s chest was beaten to a pulp after engaging in a chop battle with Rei Saito midway through the bout but he gave just as good as he got and did ample damage to the Saito brother. Shiozaki was able to land his patented Strong Arm Lariat on Jun Saito which was enough for a pinfall victory at the 26:46 mark.
 Photo Credit: All Japan Pro-Wrestling
 This was a massive win for Shiozaki & Suwama because now, even if they don’t win the tag tournament, they have a very strong argument as to why they deserve a shot at the AJPW World Tag Team Championship after beating the current champions. Jun & Rei Saito were, naturally, disappointed with the loss but vowed to repay the debt they now owe Shiozaki & Suwama.
 Photo Credit: All Japan Pro-Wrestling
 In other action, Yuma Aoyagi & Yuma Anzai defeated Hideki Suzuki & Timothy Thatcher in a Block B match to earn their first points on the tournament.
 Here are the full results of the opening day of the AJPW “REAL WORLD TAG LEAGUE 2026” tournament courtesy of purolove.com: 
 Real World Tag League – Block A : Xyon & Oddyssey [2] defeated Kento Miyahara & Hyo Ogawa [0] (6:15) after Oddyssey’s Journey’s End against Ogawa.
 Hokuto Omori & Yasutaka Yano defeated Rising HAYATO & Shota Kofuji (8:33) after Yano’s The Last Dungeon against Kofuji.
 Real World Tag League Block B : Ren Ayabe & Talos [2] defeated Daisuke Sekimoto & Kengo Mashimo (2AW) [0] (13:57) after a double chokeslam by Ayabe against Sekimoto.
 Ryuki Honda, Masayuki Kono, Dan Tamura & Seigo Tachibana defeated Cal Bloom, Shotaro Ashino, MUSASHI & Seiki Yoshioka (10:00) after Honda’s final vent against MUSASHI.
 Real World Tag League Block B : Yuma Aoyagi & Yuma Anzai [2] defeated Hideki Suzuki & Timothy Thatcher [0] (18:40) after Aoyagi’s THE FOOL vs. Thatcher.
 Real World Tag League Block A : Suwama & Go Shiozaki [2] defeated Jun Saito & Rei Saito [0] (24:46) after a Strong Arm Lariat by Shiozaki vs. Jun.
 Here are the updated tournament standings courtesy of purolove.com:
 BLOCK A 
 Xyon & Oddyssey [2]
 Suwama & Go Shiozaki [2]
 Ryuki Honda & Masayuki Kono
 MUSASHI & Seiki Yoshioka
 Jun Saito & Rei Saito [0]
 Kento Miyahara & Hyo Ogawa [0]
 BLOCK B 
 Ren Ayabe & Talos [2]
 Yuma Aoyagi & Yuma Anzai [2]
 Cal Bloom & Shotaro Ashino
 Dan Tamura & Seigo Tachibana
 Hideki Suzuki & Timothy Thatcher [0]
 Daisuke Sekimoto & Kengo Mashimo [0]
 The next AJPW “REAL WORLD TAG LEAGUE 2026”  event will be on Nov. 21st at the Shunan Nanyo Fureai Center and will feature these tournament bouts:
 Real World Tag League – Block A : Kento Miyahara & Hyo Ogawa vs. MUSASHI & Seiki Yoshioka
 Real World Tag League – Block B : Cal Bloom & Shotaro Ashino vs. Dan Tamura & Seigo Tachibana
 Real World Tag League – Block B : Hideki Suzuki & Timothy Thatcher vs. Daisuke Sekimoto & Kengo Mashimo
